descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position
• The Position
• Regional Access Manager - West A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. The Opportunity: The Regional Access manager- West region will be based at Mumbai. Role will play a strategic & crucial role in shaping healthcare access by driving comprehensive access initiatives through stakeholder engagement of public/ private entities and philanthropic organizations, enhancing the company & access to unserved customer segments in the diagnostics field of Core lab, Molecular diagnostics, Pathology, Point of care and Blood screening. This position will comprehensively manage new access through policy shaping, market development initiatives along with healthcare advocacy & public private partnerships for better patient outcomes in the assigned region. Role has significant influence over commercial priorities as a growth levers for an organization. This will also enter into/execute commercial judgement especially while planning & executing public private partnerships, value based contracting, health economic models for Roche diagnostics portfolio. This position will report in to Lead- Market access and Policy advocacy, Roche Diagnostics India and Neighbouring countries. Your responsibilities
• Develop integrated market access and payer strategies and solutions to deliver the product/solution value to payers to create the patient access opportunities. You will
• perform Diagnostics-economic analysis and health outcome analysis and will also prepare for
• reimbursement submission - dossier preparation, data gap analysis and identify the solution for
• minimizing the gap, build product value proposition for payer- and closely monitor all steps
• during the approval process.
• You will work as a member of the Roche Diagnostics India and NM team and will report to the Lead - Market Access ,, India and NM
• You will work in close collaboration with internal stakeholders to understand and inform strategic
• objectives in specified disease areas affected by public policy, including identification of
• obstacles and opportunities arising from the intersection of statue and regulation with clinical
• development decisions and product profiles.
• You will translate policy developments into meaningful guidance and strategic advice in support
• of portfolio-wide and program-specific goals and will represent Market Access in exchanges with
• internal and external senior leadership.
• Responsibilities:
• ● Manage a specific set of projects related to go-to-market roadmaps and strategic
• partnership plans with clear milestones.
• ● Understanding of commercial and government payer landscape, including
• reimbursement trends, to anticipate and adjust for potential changes in objectives and
• goals.
• ● To lead and coordinate market access projects for products in collaboration with internal
• and external partners, to coordinate and oversee projects dedicated to market access for
• all products
• ● Market access stakeholder mapping, and management.
• ● To establish strong relationships with market access stakeholders (Ministry of Health,
• Non-Government Organizations and Key Opinion Leaders), as well as participate Market
• Access initiatives/projects within region/global to represent the local organization and
• contribute.
• ● Build strong relationships, identify and establish partnerships
